name: Amazakura Misaki
source:
The son of an instrument technician who decided to pursue music due to his admiration for his father and is currently an aspiring pianist. 

After a series of events that led him to cross-dress, he became the school's new music teacher while simultaneously attending as a student. 

He has a calm demeanor and a gentle personality. 

He feels immense gratitude towards his sister, who supported his ability to study overseas. He tries his best as a teacher due to his serious personality. 

To be chosen as a member of the quartet, he trains overtime and spares no effort.
